name: ID Medical Devices LLC
old_description: Leading The Industry In The Newest Medical Device Innovations
about:
ID Medical Devices LLC operates from Fort Lauderdale, Florida, supplying medical devices and scientific equipment to healthcare and industrial buyers. The company's website carries a 2023 copyright, though a founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed publicly. No founder names or background on the company's origins appear in its public materials.

The firm distributes a catalog that includes the Stemtox-A, Eye Device, Elevare Red, Face & Body Slimming RF, and Full Body LED Device, alongside broader healthcare, industrial, and scientific supplies. It positions itself as a wholesale source, offering bulk purchasing and pricing described as lower than other suppliers. The company states that its up-to-date industrial knowledge enables it to cater to specialized procurement needs.

Customers span clinical practices, research facilities, and industrial operations that require medical-grade devices and related consumables. The company emphasizes direct communication for volume quotes and product inquiries, with a contact form that captures company name, contact details, and zip code to route requests.

ID Medical Devices highlights competitive pricing and responsive service as its primary differentiators, noting that its team works in the healthcare industry and aims to align product selection with buyer needs. The site also features a video overview of the Stemtox-A product line.
type_evidence: We offer a vast amount of Healthcare, Industrial, and Scientific supplies and equipment.
